navigation_contract.navigation: Passive destinations only. Opening a feature card or its information modal must not execute a feature action.
navigation_contract.user_action: Existing side-effecting handlers belong in user_action and may run only after an explicit user action; do not invoke them when opening the information modal.
navigation_contract.parameters: Parameters describe the existing handler inputs. The application currently dispatches DOM data-act/data-* events, not registry JSON directly; an adapter is not yet implemented.

modal_binding.note: modal_id is a stable planned lookup key for matching a registry entry to library content. The modal library does not define these IDs, and index.html does not currently connect 135 registry entries to UI modals.
